risk.adminListen: Changes the admin UI listen address you are using (after a restart)
risk.lanOnly: Turns on "LAN access only" while you are connecting from outside the LAN
risk.forceHTTPS: Turns on Force HTTPS while you are on HTTP; the HTTPS address it redirects to may not be reachable through your current path
risk.listenUnavailable: {hop} would listen on {addr}, which can't be used on this machine, so it will fail to start ({error})

dialogTitle: This change affects how you are connected
noteConfirm: If you save anyway, the admin UI checks over a new connection that it can still reach Gately; if that can't be confirmed within {seconds} seconds, the previous configuration is restored automatically.
noteNoConfirm: Confirm after saving is off: if you lose access after saving, the only way back is gately rollback on the server.
cardHelp: The Gately forwarding your connection to this admin UI passes through. You are warned before saving changes to these rules, listeners or sites; outer programs on this machine such as frp or Cloudflare Tunnel show as "This machine".
holdNote: If this is a deliberate multi-step change (you will change something else next to match), choose "Stage, apply together later": this change is saved but not applied, your current access is unaffected, and you click "Apply all" at the top of the page when everything is done.
